versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.3

- Major update to clarify and enforce the meeting extraction response format.
- Added a "CRITICAL: RESPONSE FORMAT" section detailing that all meeting results, action items, filename, and add-to-to-do-list prompt must be presented in ONE single message.
- Made numbered action items in chat and to-do prompt mandatory for all outputs.
- Strict naming and file attachment requirements enforced (e.g., filenames must be date-first).
- Listed explicit rules for what to always/never do to ensure clarity and reliability for users.

v1.0.2 — No code changes in this release.

- Version bumped to 1.0.2.
- No other user-facing changes.v1.0.2 — Display + Attach Fix

🔧 FIXES
- Single response: Display summary in chat + attach file + to-do prompt
- No more "display meeting notes" follow-up needed
- Fixed Unicode encoding (no more garbled characters)
- Enforced YYYY-MM-DD_topic.md filename format

📋 IMPROVEMENTS
- Smart truncation: Top 5-10 items in chat, all in file
- Priority sorting: Today/Tomorrow items shown first
- Added .vtt/.srt format support (Zoom captions)

Built by Jeff J Hunter

v1.0.1 — To-Do List Tracker

- New interactive to-do tracking: after extraction, select which action items to add to your tracked list.
- Persistent todo.md with smart grouping (Overdue, Today, This Week, No Deadline, Completed).
- Daily check/reminders for overdue and undated items; manual review with "todo check".
- Simple management: mark items done/remove/update, filter by owner or deadline.
- Expanded auto-save and search of all meeting notes and action items.

v1.0.0 — Initial Release

📋 Core Features
- Extract action items with owners and deadlines
- Generate clean summaries from messy notes
- Capture decisions and open questions
- Works with any text: notes, transcripts, emails, chats

📤 Output Formats
- Plain text (default)
- Markdown
- JSON
- Slack-ready
- Email-ready

🎯 Platform Agnostic
- No Discord/Slack specific commands
- Works anywhere you can paste text
- No setup, no wizard, just works

Built by Jeff J Hunter
